hero.eyebrow: For Cambodian graduates · any job, anywhere
hero.title: Prove your fit, requirement by requirement.
hero.subtitle: Proofit reads a job post and your resume, then tells you which requirements you have already proven, which you have partly proven, and which you have no evidence for — quoting the exact line from your resume behind every verdict.

evidence.title: Coursework and projects count as evidence
evidence.body: Most tools only look for job history, so a fresh graduate is marked missing on everything. Proofit reads coursework, class projects, part-time work, volunteering and competitions as real evidence — and says honestly how far that evidence goes.

local.title: Built for the job posts you actually apply to
local.body: Paste a post from CamHR, Bongthom, or any job board in the world. If a page cannot be fetched, paste the text instead — the analysis is exactly the same.

crossborder.title: Apply abroad without guessing
crossborder.body: Pick Singapore, Japan or remote-US and Proofit adapts the resume conventions it checks, then tells you what the post actually says about visa sponsorship.

step1.title: Upload your resume
step1.body: PDF or DOCX. Every line becomes evidence — coursework, projects and part-time work included, not just employment.

step2.title: Paste the job post
step2.body: Text or a link. Each requirement is read out on its own, with its priority.

step3.title: Read your coverage
step3.body: Proven, partial or missing for every requirement, with the resume line that decided it.

onboarding.title: What Proofit does, and what it will not do
onboarding.line1: It checks your evidence against every requirement in the post, one requirement at a time.
onboarding.line2: It never invents experience. Every suggestion is built only from lines already in your resume.
onboarding.line3: It does not promise to beat any hiring software. It shows you requirement coverage.

results.title: Your requirement coverage

coverage.tooltip: Required items carry more weight than preferred ones, which is why the two figures differ.
coverage.weighting: Weighted: proven = 1, partial = 0.5, missing = 0. Preferred requirements count half.

about.title: About Proofit
about.method: Proofit turns the job post and your resume into the same structure, then judges each requirement against your evidence records one at a time. Every verdict cites either the resume line that proves it or an explicit reason nothing matched.
about.limits: Proofit is a study aid, not a hiring decision. It can misread an unusual resume layout or a scanned PDF, it can disagree with a recruiter, and it will never claim experience you do not have.
about.team: Proofit is a final-year project by two students at the American University of Phnom Penh.
about.legality: We read robots.txt before fetching from any job board, we rate-limit our requests, and we store a structured extract with a link back rather than a copy of the post. We never fetch from Facebook or LinkedIn — paste the text instead.
